title: Snowboard on any ski resort of the world
author: zfyl
selftext:
So i was developping a ski resort map app, that has all the ski resorts. Got bored because of the lack of dopamine.

Made a game for myself aided with Claude 🔥 

What do you think? Would you like to give it a go on your local resort?
